result.summary: Release decision: RELEASE. All 5 acceptance criteria from GitHub issue #289 verified against source and test evidence. All NFR benchmarks pass with wide margin (NFR-01/02/04). Zero blockers. During verification, discovered and documented a separate, out-of-scope defect: migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql never actually creates the secrets table in dev/test DBs (guard checks to_regclass('instance_projections') which only exists under tenant_default schema, not public) -- confirmed via direct psql query that no secrets table exists in either DB. This means zero pre-existing plaintext-era rows exist (nothing to migrate/re-wrap), and also means the module is currently non-functional end-to-end pending a separate migration fix. Recommend ORCH register this as a new issue after this run.

issues.description: migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql secrets table creation guard never fires against the actual tenant schema in dev/test DBs -- secrets table does not exist. Separate from ISS-0074, needs its own WF-03 run.
